nodes.name: Workshop road bike
nodes.description: Ditch the city bike, unlock component tuning, and multiply Tour output.

nodes.name: Frame laboratory
nodes.description: Move from alloy to increasingly lighter and more aerodynamic carbon frames.

nodes.name: Road tires
nodes.description: Faster compounds, lower rolling resistance, fewer expensive explosions.

nodes.name: Drivetrain
nodes.description: Move through real groupsets from mechanical shifting to wireless electronic control.

nodes.name: Wheel program
nodes.description: Progress from dependable alloy wheels to light and aerodynamic carbon race wheels.

nodes.name: Braking confidence
nodes.description: Better brakes paradoxically make you descend faster. Cycling is weird.

nodes.name: Chain lubrication
nodes.description: Move from everyday oil through drip wax to a race-day hot-wax drivetrain.

nodes.name: Endurance
nodes.description: Build an engine that regards the concept of a finish line as a suggestion.

nodes.name: Sustained power
nodes.description: More watts everywhere, followed eventually by watts not recognized by science.

nodes.name: Hyperbike moonshot
nodes.description: The impossible two-billion-dollar machine. Build the economy that can afford it, then break the Tour wide open.

nodes.name: Bike handling
nodes.description: Change lanes faster, descend later, and make terrible road choices look planned.

nodes.name: Climber build
nodes.description: Improve power-to-weight without becoming a haunted pair of sunglasses.

nodes.name: Hydration protocol
nodes.description: Turn ad-hoc bottles into a measured plan for electrolytes, heat, and race duration.

nodes.name: Race fueling
nodes.description: Bananas become gels; gels become a continuous strategic carbohydrate pipeline.

nodes.name: Aero socks
nodes.description: Tiny gains, enormous confidence, increasingly indefensible invoices.

nodes.name: Aero helmet
nodes.description: Move from a basic road lid through a premium shell to a purpose-built aero helmet.

nodes.name: Race suit
nodes.description: Remove wrinkles, seams, dignity, and finally most measurable drag.

nodes.name: Gravel tires
nodes.description: Turn the Périgord farm tracks from punishment into a shortcut.

nodes.name: Micro-suspension
nodes.description: Add cockpit compliance, then a suspension stem, then a short-travel gravel fork.

nodes.name: Domestique train
nodes.description: Recruit helpers until the rider is escorted by a small cycling nation.

nodes.name: Race mechanic
nodes.description: Maintain the drivetrain and glare personally at every pothole.

nodes.name: Sponsor empire
nodes.description: Grow from local jersey support into a global title partnership.

nodes.name: Directeur sportif
nodes.description: Coordinate pacing, bottles, tactics, and suspiciously precise tailwinds.
